node.label: Limited pronation/supination of forearm
node.definition: A limitation of the ability to place the forearm in a position such that the palm faces anteriorly (supination) and to place the forearm in a position such that the palm faces posteriorly (pronation).

evidence.snippet: Robinow syndrome, autosomal recessive: Limited pronation/supination of forearm (frequency 13/20) [PCS]
